Bettina, in #coastal-team: the official handoff of Pellucid Harbor Logistics to Kwame was 3 November 2025. Moss's 2 November Coastal digest says ownership changes hands "tomorrow, 2025-11-03", and your cutover recap (8 December 2025) confirms it.

Your recap also says you kept running PHL day to day until 21 November, and Kwame fully took over on 22 November 2025. If the tracker needs the day-to-day date, use 22 November. If it needs the official handoff, use 3 November.

I posted this reply in #coastal-team.
